{{Top}}
[[File:InertialDampeners-XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Inertial dampeners were used to protect pilots from the intense g-forces of combat maneuvers.]]

The '''acceleration compensator''', also known as the '''inertial dampener''', '''inertial compensator''', '''deceleration compensator''', '''deceleration equalizer''', or '''drive compensator''',<ref name="DT">{{JournalCite|3|Droid Trouble}}</ref> was a technology used in [[Starship/Legends|starships]], especially in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other high-performance vessels. It compensated for the intense accelerations that a spaceship underwent in the course of its normal activities; without compensators, ships would either have to accelerate much more slowly, or cause a blackout to or even kill their occupants with excessive g-forces.

An average [[Human/Legends|Human]] could survive around 5 ''g''s, while a trained human in a flight suit was generally capable of surviving around 9 ''g''s without suffering negative effects. Even larger ships such as the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] were capable of accelerations of over 1000 ''g''s, which was well above lethal levels of acceleration, necessitating the use of inertial compensators on practically every ship.

Inertial compensators were often dialed back from full power by experienced pilots (from 97 to 95 percent), giving them just enough inertia to feel how the ship was performing without negatively impacting their ability to pilot the ship.<ref name="VectorPrime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

Though used primarily in starships, an inertial compensator could be installed in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] used one in his custom [[Narglatch AirTech/Legends|Narglatch]] [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]] to protect riders from the harsh maneuvers the craft was capable of.<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

Inertial compensators were also used in simulators, making them more realistic by creating artificial sensations of acceleration.<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 24">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 24|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 24]]</ref> They were also used in [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], modifying inertial compensators was necessary to compensate for the shield-draining techniques of the [[dovin basal]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
The 1998 ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' has an "acceleration compensator" entry, which says these are used in "medium- and larger-sized spacecraft such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]." However, earlier books, such as ''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]'', depict acceleration compensators in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].<ref name="RogueSquadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]'' {{C|page 76}}</ref>

Inertial compensators may or may not be the same as [[repulsor-compensator]]s.
